# Copilot instructions

Before proposing or making code changes, follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and
read the relevant documentation under `docs/`. Treat approved architecture and
documented decisions as authoritative; surface undecided choices for developer
approval.

Respect the initial backend, frontend, and shared-contract ownership boundaries
in [`docs/workflows/collaboration.md`](../docs/workflows/collaboration.md).
Avoid unrelated modules, future features not explicitly authorized, production
services, and secrets. Add relevant tests and report changed files, commands,
results, and unresolved issues. Do not push or merge automatically.
